title: Senior Program Manager - Product Portfolio & Digital Transformation
description:
Job Purpose: This role is responsible to lead portfolio-wide execution and governance across strategic product and technology programs. The role provides a single senior orchestration point across Business, Product, Engineering, QA, Production Support, Cloud / Infrastructure, InfoSec, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance and partners. The incumbent must combine strong subject command with executive presence, structured problem solving and the authority to challenge commitments, resolve cross-functional conflicts and drive timely decisions. 
 Key Responsiblities: 
 a) Portfolio strategy translation: Convert approved business and product priorities into an integrated execution plan, with outcomes, milestones, dependencies, decision points, investment needs and accountable owners. 
 b) Executive stakeholder management: Build trusted relationships with senior Business and Technology leaders. Frame issues clearly, align divergent viewpoints, secure decisions and maintain confidence through fact-based, proactive communication and tracking with proper timelines and RCAs as applicable. 
 c) Integrated planning and prioritization: Lead, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly and rolling planning across product pillars. Reconcile capacity, regulatory commitments, business-critical dates, technical dependencies and vendor plans; expose trade-offs for leadership decision. 
 d) Governance and decision architecture: Design and chair reviews, SteerCos and escalation forums. Ensure each forum has a clear purpose, accurate inputs, decision rights, actions, owners and closure discipline. 
 e) Delivery assurance: Independently assess programme health beyond reported RAG status. Validate critical path, milestones, resource assumptions, quality gates, readiness and benefits dependencies. 
 f) Cross-programme dependency management: Identify shared services, platform, data, API, security, infrastructure and partner dependencies; assign ownership and resolve sequencing conflicts before they affect delivery. 
 g) Risk, issue and escalation management: Maintain an executive RAID view, drive mitigation and trigger escalation at the right point. Distinguish decisions, risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies; prevent silent slippage. 
 h) Commercial and vendor governance: Govern delivery obligations, milestones, resource commitments, change requests, SLA performance, commercials and escalations for implementation and managed-service partners. 
 i) Financial governance: Track approved business cases, programme budgets, forecasts, purchase dependencies, change costs and benefit assumptions in partnership with Finance and procurement owners.

 Role Overview 
   
 The Solar Design Engineer is responsible for designing, analysing, and optimising solar (PV) systems for residential, commercial, and utility-scale projects. This role involves system layout design, electrical engineering, performance modelling, and code compliance while working closely with sales, project management, procurement, and construction teams to deliver safe, reliable, and cost-effective solar solutions. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end system design, technical analysis, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and project requirements.

         Strong understanding of DC/AC systems, LT/HT electrical design, and transformer yard/substation fundamentals.

title: Project Manager
description:
Responsibilities 
 Own the delivery plan One delivery plan per product, internal or customised, covering content, design and engineering, that PM, engineering and leadership all read from. Sequence hand-offs between streams so they are planned, not discovered. Track client-committed dates (CRs, pilots, renewals) and coordinate release calendars so QA, DevOps and client commitments do not collide. Make status honest and early Weekly delivery report and RAID log, published on time, with accurate sprint status in Jira for both clusters. Estimate-vs-actual and on-time percentage tracked per cluster; slippage flagged the week it becomes likely. A surprise in the metrics review is a PM miss. Prepare and run the weekly P0 review: every item owned and dated, blockers chased between reviews. Be the single point of contact Product, CS, BD and leadership route delivery queries and escalations to the PM, not the EMs. Triage each escalation: confirm impact, route to the right team, set a response date, close the loop, and log it so recurring issues surface. Escalate to the CTO when a commitment cannot be met and a trade-off is needed. Enable teams on what ships Run onboarding for internal teams when a new platform feature lands; keep release notes usable without an engineer present. Track adoption and feed gaps back to PM and engineering. Keep the process light and consistent Same definition of done, sprint rituals and ticket hygiene across both clusters. Templatise recurring artefacts (report, RAID log, release checklist) so they run themselves; supply cycle-time and on-time data to the quality diagnostic. 
 
 Skills and experience 
 
 Required 
 3 to 6 years in software delivery, of which at least 2 years coordinating multiple engineering teams (PM, scrum master, delivery lead or technical programme roles). Working fluency in Jira: boards, sprints, dashboards, JQL, and enough structure to keep two clusters consistent. Comfortable reading engineering conversations: understands what a merge request, a migration, a flaky test or a rollback means for a date. Writes clearly and briefly. A weekly report that nobody reads is a failure, so the bar is plain language and one screen. Holds people to commitments without escalating everything; knows when to chase and when to bring the CTO in. Comfortable with data: builds and maintains simple tracking sheets, reads trends, and does not report a number without checking it. 
 
 Preferred 
 Experience in a SaaS or product company shipping to enterprise clients with contractual dates. Exposure to DORA-style metrics (lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate) and how to collect them. Familiarity with GitLab CI or similar pipelines, enough to read a release status. Prior experience running a RAID log or risk register in a live programme. Any client-facing or account-coordination experience: the role increasingly fronts CR and pilot timelines to clients. 
 
 Not required 
 A PMP or Scrum certification. Useful, not decisive. Ability to write code. The role needs technical literacy, not technical output.

You operate with a high degree of rigor, transparency, and responsiveness in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Key Customer Account Management Serve as the day-to-day point of contact (POC) for the Customer's Supply Chain Management (SCM), Procurement, and Operations teams. Manage the Customer's demand forecasts (14-week rolling, MPS), translate into actionable production plans, and communicate capacity constraints proactively. Coordinate with internal teams (planning, production, quality, logistics) to ensure on-time delivery (OTD) in line with the Customer's committed ship dates. Prepare and present weekly/monthly business reviews (WBR/MBR) to the Customer's counterparts, covering OTD, quality metrics, and issue escalations. 2. Order Management & Fulfillment Own purchase order (PO) lifecycle management: receipt, acknowledgment, change order processing, and close-out. Monitor and maintain Finished Goods (FG) inventory levels at the Customer-designated hubs (VMI/consignment) to meet the Customer's fill-rate targets. Work cross-functionally to resolve supply shortages, line-down risks, and expedite requests within the Customer's procurement and ERP systems. Drive improvement in OTIF (On-Time-In-Full) and PO Fulfillment Rate KPIs tracked in the Customer's supplier scorecard. 3. NPI & Product Launch Support Coordinate customer service activities during NPI ramp, including prototype (EVT/DVT/PVT) order management and sample logistics. Support the Customer's PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) and Initial Sample Inspection Report (ISIR) submissions from a logistics and timeline perspective. Manage Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and communicate part transitions, last-time-buys (LTBs), and EOL (End-of-Life) plans to the Customer. 4. Track and close open action items in the Customer's Supplier Management Portal / Radius systems. Escalate supply risks with structured communication (STAR format: Situation, Timeline, Action, Resolution) to internal leadership and the Customer counterparts. 5. Data Analysis & Reporting Maintain accurate data hygiene in the Customer's iSCM, SAP, and internal ERP systems. Generate weekly delivery performance reports, inventory aging analysis, and demand variance summaries. Drive continuous improvement in key CS metrics: OTIF, Forecast Accuracy, Response Time SLA, Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT).

MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is a plus. Experience 5+ years of experience in customer service, supply chain, or program management roles within a manufacturing environment. description:
SafEarth Renewables Pvt Ltd delivers Owners Engineer, project management and EPC oversight services across utility-scale solar, wind-solar hybrid and battery energy storage projects. We work on the owners side of the table protecting schedule, quality and returns from land to commissioning. This is a fresher position. You will run the coordination and documentation layer of live renewable projects under a Project Manager schedules, statutory approval files, drawing registers and reporting. The work is structured and reviewed, but it is real: the approval trackers and progress reports you maintain go to the client, the lender and to government authorities. We are looking for someone who follows up without being reminded and writes clearly.

 Maintain and update project schedules in MS Project or Primavera P6; track planned versus actual progress and escalate slippage to the Project Manager with supporting data. Maintain document control across drawing registers, technical submittals, vendor documents and approval records, under version control. Prepare daily and weekly progress reports, monthly MIS and management dashboards for client and internal review. Track purchase order status, material delivery schedules and vendor payment milestones against site requirements; flag gaps that threaten the schedule. Awareness of the renewable project lifecycle from design through commissioning, and of the CEIG and DISCOM approval process is desirable. Ability to read single line diagrams, layouts and cable schedules well enough to track them through a drawing register. Exposure to MS Projector Primavera P6, MS Excel, AutoCAD and PowerPoint is preferred; we will train on the rest. Strong written English. The ability to chase an open item across several parties until it closes. Comfortable working to deadlines across two or three projects at once. Delhi-based, with willingness to travel periodically to project sites. 
 Perks and benefits Owner-side exposure across the full project stack structural, electrical, quality and regulatory from your first year. Direct involvement in utility-scale projects, from statutory approvals through commissioning. Structured mentoring by a Project Manager, with a defined path to independent project ownership. A results-oriented work culture. Competitive pay.

description:
Role & responsibilities 
 We are looking for a Project Manager (PM) for high-rise construction using aluminum formwork (such as Mivan technology) is responsible for orchestrating a fast-paced, repetitive construction cycle to ensure the project meets tight deadlines, safety standards, and quality requirements. The primary roles and responsibilities are categorized below: 
 1. Strategic Planning & Lifecycle Management: 
 Cycle Time Optimization : Establish, monitor, and enforce the typical 4 to 7-day structural cycle per floor enabled by aluminum formwork. 
 Sequential Planning : Determining the most efficient sequence of activities, including the simultaneous casting of walls and slabs to streamline the process. 
 Resource Allocation : Identifying and allocating necessary manpower (often semi-skilled for this technology), materials, and equipment from start to finish. 
 2. Technical & Quality Supervision: Formwork Design Integration : Working with architects and engineers early in the design phase to ensure building layouts are compatible with modular aluminum panels. 
 Precision Control : Monitoring the installation of formwork to ensure dimensional accuracy, which is critical for high-rise alignment and reducing the need for plastering. 
 Pour Monitoring : Overseeing the concrete pouring process to prevent overloading panels and ensure proper curing for high-quality finishes. 
 3. Operational Logistics & Maintenance: 
 Inventory Management : Managing the procurement, on-site storage, and inventory of hundreds of precision-engineered aluminum components. 
 Formwork Reusability : Implementing cleaning and maintenance protocols after every cycle (removing residue, applying release agents) to extend the lifespan of panels for 1,000+ uses. 
 On-site Logistics : Coordinating the delivery and movement of formwork accessories like wall ties, pins, and wedges to prevent idle time. 
 4. Safety & Compliance: 
 Site Safety Protocols : Enforcing strict safety measures for high-rise environments, including the use of PPE and proper load distribution for formwork supports. 
 Personnel Training : Organizing training for laborers on assembly, striking (disassembling), and handling techniques to prevent injuries and equipment damage. 
 Regulatory Adherence : Ensuring all construction activities comply with local building codes and national safety standards (e.g., OSHA). 
 5. Financial & Stakeholder Management: 
 Budgeting & Cost Control : Tracking expenses meticulously to offset high initial formwork costs through labor and time savings. 
 Stakeholder Communication : Acting as the primary liaison between clients, consultants, and on-site teams to report progress and resolve conflicts.

Constraint Development: Architect, validate, and manage files, addressing both functional and DFT modes. Develop and manage comprehensive block-level and top-level constraints (SDC / UPF). Low-Power Implementation: Implement and verify UPF-based (Unified Power Format) low-power architectures and multi-voltage domains Programming/Scripting: Strong scripting skills in Tcl, Python, or Perl to automate flows and improve design methodologies Qualifications Experience of about 8-13 years in synthesis and STA closure. Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Ability to understand design specifications, can contribute to design planning, partitioning, and setup a feasible seed for convergence PD cycle. Extensive experience in STA closure on complex design with ability to understand the clocks structure from both functional and DFT side and provide solutions to complete design closure. Worked on synthesis of high frequency designs and come up PPA solutions to meet the targets. Good understanding of EDA tools such as Fusion Compiler, Innovus, Primetime, Tempus, VCLP, LEC. title: Sap Fico Project Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Function: Enterprise Technology Solutions Finance Products, Europe 
Experience: 10–14 years in SAP Finance, including 4+ years owning solution design and delivery of change through a partner-led development team 
Reporting to: Finance Products Lead, Europe Role Purpose Own the SAP Finance (FICO) product for Europe on the build-and-change side. The role is the accountable interface between European Finance business users and the Accenture development pod: converting business demand into the right solution design, getting it built and released on time and to quality, and owning every dependency the partner team will not own — integration, cross-functional, data, security and infrastructure. This is a product ownership role, not a coordination role. The person is expected to have an opinion on the design, to say no to the wrong design, and to be credible in front of both a Finance Controller and an Accenture solution architect. 
 Demand and solution design ownership Own the European Finance change pipeline end to end: intake, qualification, business case challenge, solution option analysis, prioritisation with process owners, and release planning. Work with business users and process owners to get to the best solution rather than the first one proposed — standard SAP over custom, global template over local workaround, reuse over rebuild. Document and defend the rationale. Review and sign off functional specifications, solution design documents and architecture decisions produced by the Accenture solution managers before build starts; ensure design fits the global template, the S/4HANA roadmap and the enterprise architecture guardrails. Assess and challenge impact on adjacent processes — O2C, P2P, R2R, tax, treasury, costing, intercompany, statutory and group reporting — before committing to a design. Maintain the product backlog, roadmap and release calendar for Finance applications in Europe, with clear prioritisation logic visible to stakeholders. Managing the Accenture delivery team Manage the Accenture pod covering solution managers, functional consultants, developers and testers: work allocation, sprint or release commitments, estimate review, dependency clearing and progress tracking. Hold the partner accountable for design quality, build quality, unit testing, documentation and on-time delivery; review estimates critically and challenge padding, scope creep and rebadged effort. Run the delivery governance cadence — design authority reviews, daily/weekly stand-ups, sprint or release reviews, defect triage, go/no-go decisions — and escalate early when a date is at risk. Own the quality gates the partner delivers into: design review, code review/ATC, SIT, UAT entry and exit criteria, cutover readiness and hypercare exit. Drive knowledge retention, documentation standards and reduced key-person dependency across the pod; sign off knowledge transfer before resource rotation. Cross-team liaison (dependencies outside the partner scope) This is a core part of the role, not an occasional extra. The Accenture team will not own these; the Product Manager does. Integration / BTP team — specify and drive interface requirements, iFlow design on SAP Integration Suite/CPI, API and event design, error handling and monitoring (AIF), interface testing windows and cutover sequencing. Data and MDM teams — master data readiness, data quality rules, migration and conversion objects, ownership of data-related design decisions. Security and GRC — role design, segregation-of-duties impact, access approvals and audit/SOX evidence for changes. Basis / infrastructure / transport management — landscape availability, transport sequencing across releases, system refresh impact on in-flight change. Other functional product teams and regional/global template owners — cross-module dependencies, template change requests, alignment where a European requirement touches the global core. Third-party and downstream systems — banking, tax engines, consolidation and reporting platforms, local statutory tools. Own the dependency and risk register for the Finance product; chase, unblock and escalate rather than waiting to be told a dependency has slipped. Stakeholder management and delivery accountability Act as the trusted point of contact for European Finance leadership, Controllers, Shared Service Centres and country Finance teams; communicate design trade-offs, timelines and constraints in business language. Manage expectations honestly on scope, cost and date — including saying no, or not yet, with a reasoned alternative. Own the plan and the date: baseline it, track it, report status without varnish, and land releases on time with no unmanaged surprises at cutover. Protect the financial close calendar — no release, cutover or freeze-window decision that puts month-end, quarter-end or year-end close at risk. Represent the Finance product in change advisory boards, architecture forums and release governance. 
 Required Skills & Experience 10–14 years in SAP with strong hands-on functional depth in FICO — GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Banking, Taxation, Product Costing, CO-PA, Intercompany, period-end close. S/4HANA experience expected. Proven track record of owning solution design and delivering change through a third-party system integrator (Accenture, TCS, Infosys, Capgemini, IBM or similar) — managing their solution managers and developers, not just receiving their output. Demonstrated experience in a large global FMCG/CPG environment of large scale — multi-country, multi-company-code, multi-currency, global template with local statutory variance, high transaction volumes, complex trade and promotional accounting. Strong integration literacy: able to write and challenge an interface requirement, understand SAP BTP / Integration Suite (CPI) patterns, IDocs, APIs and events, and debug integration issues alongside technical teams. Cross-module fluency across FI/CO to MM, SD, PP, and to reporting and consolidation layers; able to spot the downstream impact of a Finance design decision. Product management discipline: backlog and roadmap ownership, prioritisation frameworks, requirement writing, release planning, benefits tracking. Delivery methods: Agile/Scrum and SAFe alongside stage-gated project delivery; comfortable with Jira or Azure DevOps and with ServiceNow-based change governance. Change and release governance: ChaRM / Solution Manager / Cloud ALM, transport discipline, CAB, emergency change protocols, audit-ready traceability. Excellent written and spoken English; ability to influence senior Finance stakeholders and hold a partner to account without escalating everything. 
 Good to Have Experience with Central Finance, Group Reporting, Universal Journal, or a Finance transformation/S/4 conversion programme. European statutory, VAT/e-invoicing, and local compliance exposure (e-invoicing mandates, SAF-T, Intrastat)

 About Us

We specialize in technology-enabled solutions for Reimbursement Claims, Cashless Claims, Healthcare Operations, and Insurance Services , partnering with leading corporate hospital chains.

We are looking for a Techno Functional Project Coordinator who can bridge the gap between business, technology, and operations . The ideal candidate will work closely with the CTO and President to coordinate multiple projects, gather and document business requirements, manage product backlogs, ensure timely project delivery, and act as the single point of coordination between business stakeholders and development teams.

 Project Planning & Coordination

Build long-term relationships with customers and implementation partners. Handle change requests and scope discussions. 
 Technical Coordination

Understand APIs, system integrations, databases, and software architecture sufficiently to facilitate technical discussions. Track defects and ensure timely resolution. Support deployment planning and production releases. 
 Documentation & Governance

 Leadership & Team Coordination

Ensure adherence to project management methodologies and organizational standards. Escalate risks and issues proactively to the CTO and President. title: Associate Technical Project Manager
description:
Job Summary As an Associate Technical Project Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of customer projects across cloud migration, modernization, infrastructure, and AI engagements. You will work alongside Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineers to translate an approved solution into a planned, tracked, and governed delivery - and you will be the primary point of contact the customer relies on for progress, risks, and decisions. This role sits at the intersection of technology and delivery governance. You are expected to understand the technical solution well enough to challenge estimates, spot dependencies early, and hold both the team and the customer to agreed scope, effort, and timelines. Key Responsibilities Project Planning Review project proposals to ensure in-scope and out-of-scope items, effort and cost estimation, deliverables, assumptions, and the proposed architecture are clearly defined. Analyze project requirements and prepare or update project timelines, delivery methodology, RACI, milestones, and deliverables. Ensure use cases and test cases are clearly defined before the project is onboarded to the delivery team. Prepare the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) before implementation and review it with the Technical Lead. Establish timelines and milestones and plan delivery within the approved budget. Technical Project Management Develop a sound understanding of the technical deliverables and work closely with Architects and Technical Leads to identify and manage risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans. Regularly review the technical solution and implementation progress with the Technical Lead to ensure planned activities are completed within the agreed timeline. Track project scope, schedule, effort, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and as per agreed scope. Assess project risks, develop risk mitigation strategies, and implement contingency plans to minimize the impact of potential issues. Identify project blockers and follow the defined escalation hierarchy for timely resolution. Delivery Across Project Types Migration and cloud projects: Manage end-to-end delivery of cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure projects, tracking cloud-specific activities, technical dependencies, risks, and milestones with Architects and Technical Leads. Non-migration technical projects: Manage end-to-end delivery of AI PoC implementations, AI assessments, and similar engagements, ensuring requirements, use cases, test cases, technical deliverables, and timelines are clearly defined and aligned with the approved solution. Coordinate with the technical teams responsible for moving applications between Development, Test, Integration, and Production environments. Manage change requests across cloud migration activities and track all associated events to maximize system availability and avoid errors. Customer & Stakeholder Management Coordinate and conduct regular daily stand-ups and customer meetings, and maintain meeting minutes, action items, expectations, and discussion points. Prepare and share weekly project status reports covering progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and next steps. Maintain effective communication and coordination between customers, Sales, Architects, Technical Leads, Engineers, and other stakeholders. Keep clients, executives, and external partners engaged throughout the project lifecycle to sustain involvement and satisfaction.

title: Sr. Staff Engineer PD
description:
Job Summary The Physical Design Engineer delivers hands-on expertise in designing and implementing custom silicon solutions to meet detailed customer requirements. This role executes physical design flows-including synthesis, place-and-route, and verification-while applying standardized methodologies for efficient IP reuse, rapid turnaround, and high-quality tape-outs. Responsibilities Implement DFT architectures including ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, scan insertion, and analog test features Execute all phases of physical design: synthesis, floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis, place-and-route, timing closure, power/noise analysis, and signoff verification. Implement design strategies to achieve performance, area, and power targets for customer-specific ICs under lead guidance. Apply re-use methodologies, leveraging standard IP blocks, libraries, and flows to accelerate project execution. Resolve timing, congestion, and power issues in high-speed, high-density designs using EDA tools and scripting. Collaborate with RTL design, verification, DFT, and package teams to integrate requirements and ensure design convergence. Perform physical verification (DRC, LVS) and support debug for clean tape-out deliverables. Automate flows with TCL, Python, or Perl scripts to improve productivity and repeatability. Analyze design metrics and contribute to process improvements through data-driven insights. Other Responsibilities Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety Security requirements and programs. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 4+ years of hands-on physical design experience on SoCs, covering RTL-to-GDSII flows. Proficiency with EDA tools like Synopsys ICC2/Fusion Compiler, Cadence Innovus/Genus, or Mentor Calibre for synthesis, PNR, STA, and verification. Strong knowledge of STA (PrimeTime/Tempus), power analysis, and congestion mitigation techniques. Experience with scripting (TCL, Python, Perl) for flow automation and debugging. Familiarity with advanced nodes, multi-corner multi-mode (MCMM) analysis, and IP integration. Analytical mindset for tackling complex timing/power challenges and effective cross-team communication. Preferred Qualifications Experience with custom silicon for automotive, high-performance computing, or AI applications. Proactive in adopting new tools, flows, and best practices for re-use and efficiency. Detail-oriented team player committed to quality and on-time delivery.

description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale - across every customer touchpoint. By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team - spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management - enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights. Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide. Job Description Sprinklr is a leading enterprise software company for all customer-facing functions. With advanced AI, Sprinklrs unified customer experience management (Unified-CXM) platform helps companies deliver human experiences to every customer, every time, across any modern channel. Headquartered in New York City with employees around the world, Sprinklr works with more than 1,000 of the world s most valuable enterprises - global brands like Microsoft, P&G, Samsung and more than 50% of the Fortune 100. Learn more about our culture and how we make our employees happier through The Sprinklr Way. Meet our Professional Services Team! Successful value-driven Sprinklr implementations start with us. We re looking for an experienced Global Program Manager to help provide premium services to our global customer base. As a member of our team, you ll support customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate internal consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen. About the Role: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Global Program Manager to lead the large-scale, complex global rollout of Sprinklr SaaS & CCaaS products. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in managing global programs, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to drive cross-functional teams towards successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities: Program Leadership: Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of the global rollout of Sprinklr SaaS & CCaaS products, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives. Stakeholder Management: Engage with key stakeholders, including senior management, clients, and cross-functional teams, to ensure clear communication and alignment on program goals and progress. Resource Management: Allocate, coordinate and manage resources across different regions and functions effectively to ensure timely delivery of program milestones. Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with the program to ensure smooth execution. Performance Tracking: Monitor program performance using appropriate systems, tools, and techniques; report on progress, issues, and risks to stakeholders. Continuous Improvement: Implement best practices and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program efficiency and effectiveness. Compliance: Ensure all program activities comply with relevant regulations, standards, and organizational policies. Financial Management: Manage program budgets, monitor expenditures, and ensure financial targets are met. Mentorship : Supervise and mentor program teams, providing guidance and support to ensure project success. Experience and Qualifications: Education: Bachelors degree in business administration, Project Management, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. Experience: Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in program management, with at least 5 years managing large-scale, global programs. Certifications: PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent program management certification is highly desirable. Technical Skills: Strong understanding of SaaS and CCaaS products & technology. (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Avaya, Cisco, Genysis etc.) Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to various audiences. Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions. Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Negotiation & Conflict Management: Experience in negotiation and conflict resolution to manage stakeholder expectations and drive consensus. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): On-Time Delivery: Percentage of program milestones delivered on or before the scheduled date. Budget Adherence: Percentage of program budget adherence, ensuring costs do not exceed allocated budget. Stakeholder Satisfaction: Stakeholder satisfaction scores based on feedback from clients, senior management, and team members. Risk Mitigation: Number of identified risks successfully mitigated or managed without impacting program delivery. Resource Utilization: Efficiency of resource allocation and utilization, ensuring optimal use of available resources. Quality of Deliverables: Quality assessment scores of program deliverables, ensuring they meet or exceed defined standards. Team Performance: Performance metrics for cross-functional teams, including productivity and collaboration effectiveness. Continuous Improvement: Implementation of process improvements and best practices, measured by the number of initiatives successfully adopted. Desired Soft Skills: Emotional Intelligence: Ability to understand and manage your own emotions, and those of others, to foster a positive work environment. Collaboration: Strong team player with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams across different geographies. Conflict Resolution: Skilled in resolving conflicts and negotiating win-win solutions.
